title: Insurtech Podcast:
description: Insurtech Canada founder John Harvey interviews BlueMind App founder Akil Balachandran how BlueMind is empowering financial advisors to be at their best.
html:
BlueMind; Freeing the minds of Advisors!

We sit down with BlueMind App founder Akil Balachandran to talk about helicopters, flying objects and how BlueMind is keeping things smart and blue by empowering financial and insurance advisors to be at their best at all times!

BlueMind was born with a single thought in mind, to provide advanced technological solutions such as artificial intelligence, not to replace advisors, but to support the global community of financial institutions, and advisors to help their clients effectively.
